data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), after an enemy unit finishes a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**.

**Target:** A **SCINTILLATING LEGIONS** unit of yours up to 8" from that enemy unit, not in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy unit.

**Effect:** The unit can carry out a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)** of at most D6", or of at most 6" while wholly within 6" of a **THOUSAND SONS** unit of yours.
